name: astro-creative-page
description: Structure and architecture for creative Astro sites: multi-page sites with client-side page transitions, persistent UI, one cleanup Scope per page and Lenis + GSAP scroll; immersive single-canvas WebGL/WebGPU experiences with a virtual, looping scroll; component-per-section pages ported from exports; a /learn guide inside the same project; study-build conventions and verification.
